transcript: Never start your morning without saying these four things to yourself. The last one will change the way you walk into your day. But first, save this and send it to someone you care about. One gratitude. Thank you for this new morning. Thank you for the breath in my lungs and the light that woke me up. Another chance to grow. Another chance to love. Another chance to try again. Even in the smallest things there is quiet beauty. Two, strength. Today I will meet whatever comes with steady energy. I have strength for what I cannot yet see. Patience for people. Wisdom for decisions. And when I feel weak, I will slow down, not give up. Three, guidance. May my steps be intentional. May my words be calm. May my reactions be controlled. May my intentions stay clean. Let clarity guide me, not emotion. Four, surrender and renewal. I release what I cannot control. My plans, my worries, my fears. I begin this day with peace in my chest and focus in my mind. Whatever happens, I will walk through it with dignity, pause, breathe. Now begin. Write in the comments, peace. If this spoke to you, and if you feel that four reminders are not enough, that what you truly need is to learn how to carry this calm with you. Not just this morning, but every single day. To silence the noise inside. To stop reacting and start living from a place of stillness. I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to build that kind of peace from within. And everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. Sometimes one quiet page in the morning can change the direction of a restless mind. The link is in my profile.
